$description: Design-system radius scale — Ben's 4-multiple override of the brand's 6/10/16/24 (BRAND-RECONCILIATION.md). The design system owns scale implementation; this is not a breaking brand change. Updated 2026-08-10 (WORK-BACKLOG CC-2 iOS consistency follow-up): web renders almost entirely via raw Tailwind rounded-* classes rather than these rounded-curio-* tokens (0 real usages found), but the underlying pixel values it actually ships are real data worth matching. rounded-xl (12px) is the single most-used radius class app-wide (179 uses) — more than every existing tier except md — and had no tier at all. Inserted as md=12, renumbering the old md(8px, 190 combined real uses, now the most-used value)->sm and old sm(4px, no current real-usage evidence)->xs; lg=16 and feature=24 are unchanged. Still a clean 4-multiple ladder throughout.

xs.$description: Chips, inputs, small controls. No current real-usage evidence on web — kept for forward design-system completeness.

sm.$description: Buttons, cards, default. The most-used radius value on web (rounded-lg + arbitrary [8px], 190 combined real uses).

md.$description: The single most-used named radius class on web (rounded-xl, 179 real uses) — was previously unrepresented in this scale.

feature.$description: Feature moments, hero cards. No current real-usage evidence on web — kept for forward design-system completeness.
